{
  "name": "browser-workflow-capture-scripts",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Test scripts for browser workflow capture application",
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "test:mcp": "node test_mcp_sdk.js",
    "test:mcp:local": "node test_mcp_sdk.js --local",
    "test:mcp:production": "node test_mcp_sdk.js",
    "test:mcp:python": "python test_mcp_python_sdk.py --production",
    "test:mcp:python:local": "python test_mcp_python_sdk.py",
    "health:mcp": "node test_mcp_quick.js",
    "health:mcp:local": "node test_mcp_quick.js --local",
    "health:mcp:python": "python test_mcp_python_quick.py",
    "health:mcp:python:local": "python test_mcp_python_quick.py --local",
    "example:mcp": "node mcp_integration_example.js",
    "example:mcp:local": "node mcp_integration_example.js --local",
    "quote:test": "node test_specific_quote.js",
    "quote:test:local": "node test_specific_quote.js --local"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk": "^1.0.0"
  },
  "keywords": [
    "mcp",
    "workflow",
    "automation",
    "testing"
  ],
  "author": "Browser Workflow Capture Team",
  "license": "MIT"
}
